verdict.rationale: Wave documents some built-in automations, such as recurring invoices, scheduled overdue reminders and bank-transaction auto-categorization. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to version those automations, review changes to them, or roll them back. Switching recurring billing between automatic and manual is an adjacent control, not version history or rollback, so the applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
